review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer, IT Operations and Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: Who We Are At Firestorm, we are building the future of expeditionary defense manufacturing and autonomous systems. Modern conflict has exposed a fundamental problem: the systems needed most by operators are often too expensive, too slow to produce, and too difficult to sustain at scale. Firestorm exists to change that. We develop mission-adaptable aerial systems and deployable manufacturing infrastructure designed to put capability directly into the hands of the warfighter. From modular unmanned aircraft to xCell — our deployable microfactory — our goal is to make defense systems rapidly deployable, adaptable, and producible at the point of need. We are looking for builders, operators, and problem-solvers who want to work on meaningful technology with real-world impact. About The Role Firestorm builds uncrewed aircraft and the manufacturing network that produces them: full-capability plants, deployable xCell edge factories, and forward-deployed sites that stand up production near the point of need. Crucible is the software that runs that network. It runs in the cloud, inside a factory, and air-gapped in classified environments. At the edge, Crucible has to operate reliably on local compute, connect to factory equipment, and keep working when cloud infrastructure and internet connectivity are unavailable. We are hiring a Systems Engineer to support critical business operations, infrastructure in the cloud and on-premise, Microsoft 365 GCC-High, Amazon-Gov and other systems. What You’ll Do Infrastructure Provisioning & Maintenance: Deploy, configure, patch, and manage physical servers, virtual machines, cloud instances (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise storage. System Monitoring & Health Checks: Implement and maintain observability tooling (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch) to track system performance, resource utilization, and uptime. Incident Response & Triage: Serve as an escalation point for system outages and critical alerts; lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and document post-mortems to prevent recurrence. Automation & Scripting: Write and maintain scripts (Bash, Python, PowerShell) and infrastructure-as-code configurations (Terraform, Ansible) to automate routine operational tasks and deployments. Network & Connectivity Management: Monitor core network services (DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routing, and firewalls) to maintain secure, low-latency communication across environments. Backup & Disaster Recovery: Design, schedule, test, and verify automated backups, data replication, and disaster recovery plans to ensure strict Recovery Point and Recovery Time Objectives (RPO/RTO). Security & Compliance: Apply system hardening standards, manage access control (IAM/Active Directory/SSO), audit system logs, and remediate CVE vulnerabilities in coordination with the security team. Capacity Planning & Performance Tuning: Analyze compute, storage, and network trends to optimize system performance and forecast hardware or cloud resource scaling needs. Documentation & Standard Operating Procedures: Author and update runbooks, system architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational workflows for team use. Required Qualifications U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance Operating Systems: Deep operational proficiency with Linux distributions (RHEL, Ubuntu, Rocky) and/or Windows Server environments, including OS hardening, kernel tuning, and troubleshooting. Scripting & Automation: Strong practical scripting skills in at least one language (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) to automate administrative tasks and repetitive workflows. Networking Fundamentals: Solid understanding of core networking protocols and services (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, HTTP/S, SSH, VPNs, and firewall rules). Virtualization & Cloud: Hands-on experience administering virtualized infrastructure (VMware ESXi/vCenter, Hyper-V, KVM) or public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Monitoring & Tooling: Experience configuring and operating enterprise monitoring, logging, and APM tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, ELK, or CloudWatch). Experience with Microsoft GCC-High environments, AWS-Gov and similar secure environments that have CUI and ITAR data Experience with CMMC v2 and NIST 800.171 compliance needs Preferred Qualifications Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Working knowledge of configuration management and provisioning tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or SaltStack. Containerization: Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, ECS). Identity & Security: Experience managing enterprise directory services, IAM, and SSO protocols (Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta, SAML, LDAP). Disaster Recovery: Direct experience designing, executing, and auditing multi-site backup strategies and failover simulations (e.g., Veeam, Zerto, AWS Backup). Experience with High Performance Compute (HPE, Supermicro) Experiene with Enterprise Storage (NetApp) Work Environment This role is based in San Diego, CA. We welcome candidates who are local or open to relocating; relocation assistance is available and may be included in the offer package where appropriate. Compensation US Salary Range: $116,000 – $138,000 USD The posted salary range reflects an estimate based on a variety of compensation factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, education, certifications, specialized skills, geographic location, and business needs. Actual compensation may vary, and this range is subject to change as our compensation structure or market conditions evolve. Benefits & Perks Our culture fosters collaboration, respect, and trust, empowering passionate people to do their best work. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career growth. In addition to an opportunity to take part in an innovative, collaborative and fast-growing business with a highly motivated and skilled team, we also take pride in taking care of our employees. Here are just a few ways that we show our appreciation: We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and visions plans 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan to invest in your long-term retirement goals Equity grants for new hires Unlimited PTO Extremely generous company holiday calendar, including a holiday hiatus in July & December. Generous Parental Leave Lifestyle Spending Account FSA DCFSA HSA Hospital Indemnity insurance Critical Illness insurance Accident insurance Basic Life/AD&D, short-term and long-term disability insurance, 100% covered by Firestorm. Plus, the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your family. Mental Health Resources: We provide free mental health resources 24/7 including therapy and more. Additional work-life services, such as free legal and financial support, are available to you as well. Export Control Compliance To conform to U.S. government export control regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or otherwise eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce. Equal Opportunity Statement Firestorm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and upholding equitable hiring practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic under federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process. Firestorm is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require accommodations or assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at careers@launchfirestorm.com so we can provide the support you need.

review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer – MSP Automation
review_candidates.location: City of Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa
review_candidates.description: Job Description The  Centralized Services Engineer I  (Senior Systems Engineer – MSP Automation) plays a pivotal role within ITS by ensuring seamless operation, optimization, and advancement of both internal and client-facing IT environments. This position requires a highly skilled professional with expertise in infrastructure architecture, cloud systems, MSP tools, and automation. The successful candidate will act as a critical escalation point for the internal helpdesk team while driving innovation through scripting, automation, and tool integrations. Additionally, this role includes responsibilities related to backup infrastructure architecture, deployment, verification, and remediation escalation, specifically utilizing Veeam as the backup solution.  Job Responsibilities Escalation and Support Serve as the escalation point for complex issues unresolved by the internal helpdesk team. Act as an escalation point for backup remediation, ensuring critical data recovery and system integrity. Onboarding and Offboarding Oversee internal user onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure a seamless experience. Manage client onboarding and offboarding, ensuring all systems, accounts, and configurations are properly set up or decommissioned. Infrastructure Architecture and Maintenance Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot datacenter and cloud infrastructure, focusing on Windows and Azure environments. Develop and maintain backup infrastructure architecture using Veeam to ensure reliable data protection and recovery. Backup Management Design, deploy, and maintain Veeam backup solutions for internal and client environments. Perform regular backup verification with Veeam to ensure integrity and recoverability of data. Escalate and remediate backup failures, ensuring minimal downtime and data loss. Optimize Veeam backup policies and strategies for efficiency, compliance, and security. RMM (Remote Monitoring and Management) Maintain and troubleshoot the ConnectWise Automate platform. Develop and optimize RMM scripts and automation workflows to improve efficiency and reduce manual tasks. MDM (Mobile Device Management) Maintain and troubleshoot Addigy and Intune platforms. Create and manage MDM scripting and automation solutions to streamline mobile device management. PSA (Professional Services Automation) Maintain and troubleshoot ConnectWise Manage to ensure smooth operation of service delivery workflows. Tool Integration and Management Conduct proof-of-concept evaluations for new MSP tools. Integrate tools within the MSP environment to enhance operational efficiency. Patching Management Architect and maintain Windows and third-party patching processes to ensure compliance and security. Documentation Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for infrastructure, tools, and processes. Document Veeam backup configurations, verification processes, and remediation procedures. Job Qualifications Education and Experience Relevant Microsoft certifications Networking certifications advantageous 3+ years of experience in a similar role within an MSP environment Technical Skills Expertise in Windows Server, Azure infrastructure, and cloud technologies. Proficiency with RMM tools (ConnectWise Automate) and PSA platforms (ConnectWise Manage). Strong scripting skills in PowerShell or similar languages. Experience with MDM platforms (Addigy, Intune). Familiarity with MSP tools and their integrations. Experience with database platforms (MSSQL, MySQL). Adept at networking (Cisco, HPE, Dell, SonicWall, FortiGate). Strong understanding of backup infrastructure architecture, deployment, and verification using Veeam. Experience with Veeam backup solutions and troubleshooting backup failures. Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Detail-oriented with a focus on process improvement. Skilled in documentation. Job Requirements A home office set up that meets the following: Computer: A working computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM and one of the following: Windows 11 with an Intel i5 or i7 (8th generation or newer), or AMD Ryzen 5 or 7 (2000 series or newer), or macOS 12 or newer. Internet: Stable internet connection with at least 5 Mbps download and upload speeds. Audio Equipment: A quality headset with a noise-cancellation feature for meetings. Mobile Device: A smartphone capable of installing the Microsoft Authenticator app. Webcam: An HD webcam for video calls. 2nd Monitor  UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) if using a desktop (Not needed if using a laptop) A very strong cultural fit the ITS way (Our core values will be discussed during the interview)  Excellent command of the English language both spoken and written  Able to work full time 40 hours a week -  8:00AM to 5:00PM, Pacific Standard Time (PST) from Monday to Friday. Able to pass our online behavior and cognitive assessments.  Preferably have at least 2 of the following certifications: CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, 3cx Basic Certified Engineer. Able to provide NBI Clearance (for PH applicants). Compensation Pay rate starts at  $13.00/hr  and may vary by experience and location. Benefits Comprehensive Health Plans / HMO (Employee & Dependent/s) Life Insurance Flexible Benefit Reimbursement (Dental/Vision/Mental Health/Wellness/Government Contributions) Paid Time Off (starts at 15 days per year) Maternity/Paternity Leave Paid US Holiday Night Shift Bonus Salary Advancement/Loan Health & Wellness Program Company-paid training and certification

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer I
review_candidates.description: Mission Produce is the global leader in the worldwide avocado business, with additional offerings in mangos. Since 1983, we have invested in people, state-of-the-art technology, and avocado-specific and ripening infrastructure to expertly serve our customers, growers, and partners in over 27 countries. We own and operate four packing facilities in multiple global locations including California, Mexico, and Peru. Our global distribution network includes 16 forward distribution centers in North America, China, Europe and the Netherlands, which promote company expansion into new territories and categories. Throughout our history, we have remained rooted in honesty, respect, and loyalty to provide a year-round supply of high-quality fruit from field to fork. Job Summary Under direct supervision, the Network Engineer will support Mission Produce global networks and server infrastructure for cloud environments, ERP systems, offices, data centers and remote sites. Perform routine administrative tasks such as patching and hardware upgrades/replacements, monitoring network services, responding to break/fix and support requests submitted in ticketing system. Works closely with IT Network Engineering Manager, Mission global IT groups with projects that include additions, expansions and be able to make recommendations for implementing new solutions and improvements. Work closely with vendor support and outside contractors seeing resolutions to open tickets. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Perform a variety of technical and supportive tasks related to networks, servers, workstations and peripherals including, but not limited to, the assembly, installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of hardware equipment and software. Manage and maintain all access layer network devices in Mission’s global enterprise. Plan, install, configure, and maintain local area network switches and wireless network. Perform routine scheduled maintenance, updates and patching to address security concerns and vulnerabilities applying best practices. Manage routers, switches, wireless LAN controllers, wireless Access Points. Work as a member of a team and use established standard operating procedures in the conduct of daily duties. Ability to read, create, or edit technical procedures and drawings. Minimum Qualifications & Requirements Associate degree or equivalent combination of work experience, education, and training. 3-5 years of experience in Network Administration managing routers, switches and wireless networks. Hands on experience installing, upgrading, and troubleshooting Cisco data networks and wireless networks. Strong knowledge of Cisco IOS, including routers, switches, wireless LAN controllers. Strong knowledge configuring VLAN’s and understanding of STP & RSTP. Hand on experience troubleshooting L1, L2 & L3. Ability to configure network devices using the CLI. Experience with IP networking design and operations under RFC 1918 including subnetting, VLSM, and CIDR notation. Experience troubleshooting network issues. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Understanding of well-known protocols and services: DNS, DHCP, LDAP, RADIUS, TACAC+, AAA. Ability to travel if needed to other remote sites. On-call and ability to work hours outside normal business according to business needs. Assist and works closely with IT Network Engineer Manager in configuring, implementing, and maintaining network connectivity. Ability to travel if needed to remote sites in different geographical locations. Ability to work in a manufacturing, food processing and cold storage environments. Ability to lift and rack IT equipment such as routers, switches in data centers and networking IDF's. Bilingual in Spanish is a plus. DESIRABLE CERTIFICATIONS CCNA MCP, MCSA, MCSE, MCITP, MSCE A+, Net+, Security + Salary: $97,766 - $122,207/year MISSION PRODUCE EMPLOYEE PRIVACY POLICY This Privacy Policy sets out how Mission Produce, Inc. (the “Company”) uses and protects any information that employees may give the Company in the context of their employment, job application, or other similar working relationship with the Company. This Privacy Policy also applies to the information the Company collects about employees’ emergency contacts or individuals whom the Company administers benefits relating to their employment with the Company. review_candidates.title: Technical Account Manager, APJ
review_candidates.description: Company Background Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide. As a Technical Account Manager for APJ, you will serve as the primary post-sale contact and trusted advisor to customers throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and adoption through renewal and growth. You will partner closely with Security Operations, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, and IT teams within enterprises, government agencies, and partner organizations to ensure customers realize measurable security outcomes from our platform. This role blends relationship management with hands-on technical fluency. You will guide customers on platform workflows, integrations, and API usage, translate technical capabilities into business value for executive stakeholders, and help customers operationalize Censys within their security programs. Because you will be one of the first dedicated post-sale hires in the region, you will also shape how Censys shows up for APJ customers and serve as the regional voice of the customer internally. The ideal candidate understands the business and cultural dynamics of working across APJ markets, multi-stakeholder decision-making, regional data and regulatory considerations, and partner-led engagement models and is comfortable operating with autonomy while collaborating with colleagues across time zones. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Marketing, and Engineering to advocate for APJ customers and drive long-term success across the region. What You’ll Do Own and manage a portfolio of enterprise, government, and partner accounts across APJ Act as the primary post-sale point of contact and technical advisor for your customers Build trusted relationships with security leaders, practitioners, and executive stakeholders Lead onboarding and implementation, including internal hand-offs, customer kick-offs, and integration and architecture planning Help customers deploy, test, and troubleshoot integrations (e.g., cloud connectors, Splunk, Jira, ServiceNow, SIEM/SOAR platforms) and make effective use of the Censys API Develop success plans aligned to each customer's security priorities and desired outcomes Conduct regular business reviews, adoption reviews, and roadmap discussions Educate customers on new features, platform workflows, Beta Programs, and Design Partnerships Monitor product adoption, usage trends, health indicators, and customer engagement Identify risks proactively including stakeholder turnover, low adoption, and budget risk and execute mitigation plans to improve retention Partner with Account Executives on renewals, expansion opportunities, and account strategy Identify opportunities for upsell, cross-sell, and broader platform adoption Support and enable regional channel and MSSP partners serving joint customers Support customer advocacy initiatives including references, case studies, and advisory programs Maintain accurate account forecasts, health scores, and renewal data in Gainsight and Salesforce Serve as the voice of the APJ customer internally, communicating feedback and regional market needs to Product and Engineering Coordinate with Support and Professional Services to resolve customer issues effectively Contribute to scalable customer success processes and playbooks tailored to the APJ region What We’re Looking For 3+ years of Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, or related experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, or networking Experience supporting customers across the APJ region and an understanding of how to operate effectively across its markets Solid understanding of computer networking, internet protocols, and “how the internet works” Working knowledge of security and cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and comfort discussing security concepts with practitioners Ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders Experience managing renewals and identifying expansion opportunities Strong organizational and project management skills Comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment Demonstrates curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to actively improve efficiency and impact Willingness to travel within APJ to meet with customers and partners, and periodically to Censys HQ Fluency in English required; proficiency in an additional APJ language (e.g., Japanese, Mandarin, Korean, Bahasa) is a plus What Sets You Apart Experience working with SOC, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, or Security Engineering teams Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts such as attack surface management, asset discovery, threat intelligence, or vulnerability prioritization Understanding of Layers 3 (network), 4 (transport), and 7 (application) of the OSI Model, and of SSL/TLS and certificates Scripting or programming experience (e.g., Python) and familiarity with REST APIs Experience working with government or regulated-industry customers in APJ Experience with channel or MSSP partner models Knowledge of platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk, Jira, or similar tools Previous start-up experience Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. The listed range is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified. For roles that are available to be filled remotely, the pay range is localized according to employee work location by a factor of between 83% and 100% of range. Please discuss your specific work location with your recruiter for more information. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to your recruiter. Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor). Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO. We have an integration engineer who handles the deep technical build — new EHR connections, custom API work, anything that needs code. Your job is to own the relationship and the account, configure the product yourself for everyday needs, and hand off cleanly when something genuinely needs engineering. What's yours, and what's the engineer's Being clear about this up front, because the handoff is where accounts usually get dropped: | You own | The Integration Engineer owns | The customer relationship and every open item on it | Building new EHR and system integrations Call flows, prompts, transfer rules, SMS and notification settings | Custom API work and anything needing code Getting the customer live on existing, supported integrations | Debugging the platform itself Deciding when something is a bug vs a config problem | Fixing the bug once you've escalated it Telling the customer what's happening, and when The handoff is yours to manage Escalating to the engineer does not move the account off your plate You still own the update to the customer, the timeline, and the follow-up until it's actually closed What you'll do Own a book of live accounts - Know every one — what's live, what's broken, who's quiet, who's unhappy, what's unresolved. Nothing should sit open for weeks Run follow-ups relentlessly - Open items, deals, escalations, promised call-backs. This is most of the job, and it is the part that decides whether we keep customers Take new customers live - Set up call forwarding, build their flow, connect supported integrations, then test it end to end on a real record before you tell them it works Configure the product - Flow builder, prompt builder, transfer settings, notification rules. Most customer problems are configuration, and you fix those yourself Be on the phone - Several customer calls a day — onboarding, check-ins, escalations, saves. The best outcome in this job usually starts with you calling someone before they call you Protect and grow revenue - Spot churn risk early and intervene. Work past-due invoices. Close upsells when a customer wants more than they're paying for Spot what to automate next - You're inside these businesses daily. When you see manual, repetitive back-office work, write it up and bring it to us — you won't build it, but the best ideas will come from you Write it down - Every recurring fix becomes a documented play, so the next person — or the AI — handles it without you Who This Is For You're curious about AI in a way that shows up in your actual work, not on your resume. You already use these tools daily, you have opinions about where they break, and being handed a new agent to deploy is the appealing part of this job rather than the scary part. You close loops without being chased. You post what you did and what's still broken before anyone asks. You don't say something is fixed until you've tested it yourself. When you're blocked by someone else, you go around them or escalate the same day — "waiting on them" is not a status update. You want to grow fast and you're willing to be uncomfortable to do it. This is an early team building something that changes weekly. If you want a defined scope and a stable process, this will frustrate you. How We Work We're small and remote, so a few things are non-negotiable: Non-Negotiable Expectations Know your book cold: Own every account, live status, and issue; never let leadership or the client inform you of a problem first. Nothing sits: Resolve or send a written update on open items the same day. Proactive updates: Post daily written progress reports without reminders. Fixed means tested: Verify fixes on real records; report ongoing issues directly. Simple solutions first: Pick up the phone immediately if it speeds up resolution. No blame loops: Focus strictly on finding the fix and learning the lesson. What We’re Looking For Requirements: 2+ years in B2B Customer Success, Account Management, or Tech Support owning a named account list. Hands-on software configuration experience (automations, IVR, phone trees, CRM, no-code tools)—not just logging tickets. Technical fluency: capable of reading API docs, understanding webhooks, and self-learning new tools. Daily phone communication with clients (not email-only). Proven experience carrying a retention, renewal, or upsell target. Clear, confident spoken English for live calls with US business owners and clinic staff. Full availability for live calls during US business hours. High-level written English to manage customer emails autonomously. Nice-to-Haves: Telephony experience (VoIP, call forwarding, Twilio, Dialpad, RingCentral). Background in healthcare front-office, practice management, EHR, or RCM. Prior experience at a fast-moving, <50-person startup. Familiarity with Linear, Jira, Stripe, and Slack Connect. Hands-on experience shipping an automation, agent, or script using AI tools. The Reality of the Role Single ownership: You are fully accountable for your accounts—no hand-holding or chasing. High standards: "I thought it was fixed" isn't acceptable; verify before reporting, and share bad news early. Outcome-driven: Flexible hours, but mandatory alignment with US client working hours. Demanding SMB clients: High urgency required, as downtime directly impacts their revenue. Evolving scope: Expect your responsibilities to adapt as we expand into back-office workflows. First 90 Days Day 30: Fully own the account book, call every client, clear backlogs, and independently build/test product flows. Day 60: Lead new implementations end-to-end, keep open items clear, and submit complete engineering escalations. Day 90: Proactively prevent churn, document recurring fixes, close expansion revenue, and propose new back-office automation opportunities. Location Requirements Fully remote.
